verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents self-serve, pay-as-you-go pricing with no subscription, a public pricing page with token rates and service-tier multipliers, and published per-request costs with exact token counts. Developers can buy API credits without contacting sales. missing for 10: concrete per-token or per-request dollar figures in the evidence, independent or hands-on confirmation of price clarity.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see clear per-request or per-credit pricing without talking to sales

citations.quote: Pay-as-you-go pricing for all APIs. No subscription required.
See exact token counts and published costs for every request.
every API response includes exact token counts so you know your costs per request.
The `flex` (0.5×) and `priority` (2×) service tiers change the token rates only for models that list that tier
